GREYED: homocitrate synthase R396 and its acetyl-CoA / CoA / 2-oxoglutarate / acetate transports, R92 closed; blocked before and after, not changed

Reaction colour = scenario value: capacity = max |flux| any feasible state can carry (FVA at 0 % on Task A + PO1f, uracil open, R612 closed; Gurobi 1e-9), pFBA = flux at the optimum. Grey = 0; no colour = not in this model.

Node colour (Task A): blue = every reaction blocked before, not after; orange = every reaction blocked in both; pink = only after; grey = has an unblocked reaction. Repeated nodes are the same pool. Layout is automatic.
